concepts.title: Linear Equations in One Variable Basics and Verification
concepts.definition: An algebraic statement comparing two expressions with a single variable exponent of one, verified when LHS equals RHS.
concepts.key_idea: A valid solution to a linear equation makes the left-hand side expression equal to the right-hand side expression.
question_patterns: in Class 8 linear equations: verify if x = {val} is a solution to {eq}
check whether {val} satisfies the linear equation
determine if {val} is the root of the given equation
test if substituting {val} makes LHS equal to RHS
is {val} a valid solution for the algebraic equation

solution_steps.explain: Substitute the value of the variable into the left hand side expression.
Substitute the value of the variable into the right hand side expression.
Check if LHS equals RHS; if equal, the given value is a valid solution.

concepts.title: Solving Linear Equations with Variable Terms on Both Sides
concepts.definition: Linear equations of the structure a*x + b = c*x + d where variable terms are present on both sides of the equal sign.
concepts.key_idea: Group variable terms onto one side and constant values onto the opposite side via transposition.
question_patterns: in Class 8 linear equations: solve for x in {a}x + {b} = {c}x + {d}
calculate the value of variable x when {a}x + {b} = {c}x + {d}
find the solution of linear equation {a}x + {b} = {c}x + {d}
determine the unknown x satisfying {a}x + {b} = {c}x + {d}
what is the value of x in {a}x + {b} = {c}x + {d}

solution_steps.explain: Transpose constant b from left hand side to right hand side.
Transpose variable term c*x from right hand side to left hand side.

solution_steps.action: Divide difference of constants by difference of coefficients

concepts.title: Solving Linear Equations with Parentheses
concepts.definition: Linear equations containing brackets requiring distribution of factors across terms prior to combining like terms.
concepts.key_idea: Expand brackets using the distributive law before collecting variable terms and constants.
question_patterns: in Class 8 linear equations: solve {a}(x + {b}) = {k}
calculate x from equation {a}(x + {b}) = {k}
find the value of variable in {a}(x + {b}) = {k}
determine the root of {a}(x + {b}) = {k}
what is x when {a}(x + {b}) = {k}

solution_steps.explain: Apply distributive law a*(x + b) = a*x + a*b.

solution_steps.action: Subtract product from right hand constant

concepts.title: Reducing Equations with Rational Denominators
concepts.definition: Linear equations containing rational terms cleared by multiplying both sides by the denominator.
concepts.key_idea: Multiplying every term by the denominator removes fractions to form a simple linear equation.
question_patterns: in Class 8 linear equations: solve (a*x + b)/m = c

calculate the variable x when (a*x + b)/m = c
determine the solution for (a*x + b)/m = c

solution_steps.action: Multiply right side constant c by denominator m
solution_steps.explain: Clear denominator by multiplying both sides by m.
